scope: Post-test development diagnostic of frame-start relabeling alone for all three frozen visual models and both saved initialization choices; no parameter or timing selection.

plan.scope: Post-test development diagnostic of frame-start relabeling alone for all three frozen visual models and both saved initialization choices; no parameter or timing selection.
plan.envelopeMethod: Minimum and maximum over interval endpoints, stimulus boundaries and all analytical two-exponential derivative roots. Bounds expanded by fixed 1e-13 fractional-fluorescence padding for roundoff; not formal interval arithmetic. Squared distance to each interval gives an optimistic lower bound allowing a separate phase or convex phase mixture at every observation.
interpretationLimits: Natural acquisition is 354.4 Hz. The 82.4-Hz flash rate must not be substituted. The archived natural extractor labels the first strictly post-onset frame as time zero.
Prediction is evaluated at t+delta for every prescribed offset in [0,1/354.4] seconds. All complete predictions and metrics retained; no best phase chosen or installed.
Original input sequence, parameters, point observation rule and positive periodic-cycle normalization denominator remain fixed. Startup also uses the original periodic denominator.

The optimistic pointwise envelope contains any common phase and any convex phase mixture, but a bound below zero-response MSE does not demonstrate any realizable common phase or mixture that beats zero.
Frame-start relabeling alone is narrower than all acquisition uncertainty. ROI within-frame scanning/integration and the unverified compact corrected-export lineage remain outside this bound.
Previously evaluated responses are development data. This diagnostic cannot reverse the original failed transfer result, qualify new physiology, or establish chemical steering.
